stories.story_fr: MSCI signe au T1 2026 son meilleur trimestre de ventes nettes nouvelles d'abonnements recurrents depuis 2022, avec des niveaux record de ventes Q1 dans Index et Analytics et chez les hedge funds et banques.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026 MSCI delivered its best quarter of recurring net-new subscription sales since 2022, with record Q1 recurring sales in Index and Analytics and with hedge funds and banks.
stories.quote: including a record asset-based-fee run rate and our best Q1 of recurring net-new subscription sales since 2022.

stories.story_fr: MSCI affirme renforcer son role d'infrastructure essentielle de l'investissement mondial via une innovation produit dopee a l'IA, et se dit bien positionne pour en tirer parti.
stories.story_en: MSCI is reinforcing its role as the essential intelligence layer of global investing through relentless, AI-fueled product innovation and positions itself to benefit from AI.
stories.quote: we are building on it through relentless, AI-fueled product innovation ... MSCI is well positioned to benefit from AI and use it to increase the value of our solutions

stories.story_fr: Le Run Rate des frais sur actifs progresse de 26% sur un an au T4 2025, porte par des encours record dans les ETF et fonds indexes repliquant les indices MSCI.
stories.story_en: Asset-based fees Run Rate grows 26% year-over-year in Q4 2025, driven by record AUM in ETF and non-ETF funds indexed to MSCI indexes.
stories.quote: a record asset-based-fee run rate driven by record inflows into ETF products linked to our indexes

stories.story_fr: La fidelite client reste tres elevee avec un taux de retention trimestriel de 95,4% au T1 2026 (93,4% au T4 2025), confirmant la robustesse du modele d'abonnement recurrent.
stories.story_en: Client stickiness stays very high with a 95.4% quarterly retention rate in Q1 2026 (93.4% in Q4 2025), confirming the resilience of the recurring subscription model.
stories.quote: Retention Rate in first quarter 2026 was 95.4%, compared to 95.3% in first quarter 2025.

stories.story_fr: Au T4 2025, MSCI atteint sa 11e annee consecutive de croissance a deux chiffres du BPA ajuste, signe de la regularite de son modele.
stories.story_en: In Q4 2025 MSCI reached its 11th straight year of double-digit adjusted EPS growth, a mark of the consistency of its model.
stories.quote: achieving a number of key milestones, including our 11th straight year of double-digit adjusted EPS growth
